scenario: Review this design: single Postgres instance holds (short_code, long_url); short codes generated by hashing the long URL and taking the first 7 base62 characters; no caching layer; single app server behind a load balancer; redirect endpoint reads Postgres on every request.
required_behaviors: identifies the hash-collision handling gap as a correctness risk, not just a scaling concern
identifies the missing cache as a risk given the read-heavy, skewed access pattern typical of this system type
states assumptions explicitly since no scale target was given
produces a prioritized, not flat, list of recommended changes
forbidden_behaviors: reviewing against an assumed scale target without stating it as an assumption
grading_notes: Pass if both critical risks in the reference example are independently identified.
